title: Mixed Event — Unfading Wishing — Episode6 Exchanging Thanks

meta.Event Outline: The US trip is coming up fast, and Akito's been practicing at full throttle. He takes a well-earned break on New Year's Day, but while he's out and about, he ends up running into a certain someone...

rows.Line: Shopping Mall

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: We really ended up getting into it, huh...

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Yeah, time really flew by while we were there.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: But playing with all those toys and games was very enjoyable.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line:
Yeah.
It ended up being pretty fun.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Anyway, we all got what we need, so we should probably...

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: No, wait...!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Hm? What's up?

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line:
The plushie in that claw machine...
Isn't that Lazy Hippo?!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Lazy Hippo?

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line:
It's been all the rage on social media!
It's got this strange look of apathy on its face, but it works so well for some reason...

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
Yeah, I also remember seeing it online.
Some of our fans even said they really like its design.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: People actually like that thing?

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line:
Yes, they do!
It's become so popular that the claw machines at most arcades are out of them.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line:
So, can I go give this one a try?
I promise to be right back!

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line:
You promise to be right back?
Something tells me that you're going to come back whining about how you can't get it.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line:
Oh, don't worry!
I've got Toya on my side!

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Hey, don't make him do all the work.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line:
I'll be the one operating the claw!
So, Toya, can you tell me where I should aim and stuff?

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Yes, I'll do my best to help.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: See? He said he'd help.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: I guess we should let them do this.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Yeah, I guess...

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: But I still feel like this is going to take a while, so I'm gonna go buy some drinks. Want anything, Toya?

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line:
Ah, thank you.
Some coffee would be much appreciated.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: If you're going, then I'll have some hot chocolate.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line:
You're so shameless...
Anyway, Momoi, would you like anything?

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Me? I'll...

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
Actually, Akito, I'll go with you.
Carrying all those drinks by yourself probably wouldn't be easy.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: No, I should be fine...

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
I insist!
So, let's go!

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: O-Okay...

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Thanks, you two!
A few minutes later

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: I didn't think finding hot chocolate would be this hard...

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line:
I'm sorry, Momoi.
I didn't mean to make you fulfill her selfish request.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
It's okay.
I actually also happen to be in the mood for some hot chocolate. So, let's see if they have some up on the next floor.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line:
Thank you.
I sure hope they do...

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: <Then, why don't you do that today?>

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: <You're all here together like this, so you may get a chance to do so today.>

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Um, Akito?

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Yes?

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
So, the thing is...
I've been meaning to tell you something.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Tell me?

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Yeah, so...

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: When we were both still in junior high, do you remember us meeting on Vivid Street?

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Yes, vividly.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Does that mean you also remember what I asked you to do that time?

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Yes, I do.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: I see...

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Akito...

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Thank you so much, for then until now. And also, I'm sorry.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line:
...!
No, Momoi, you don't have to apologize.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Seriously, there's no call for that. Why would you...

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: I wanted to thank you because you've been a huge source of support for Ena.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: She's back to trying to become an artist again, partly because she found the strength within herself...

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: But also, you and everyone in her group have played a huge role throughout this whole process.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: So, thank you. For being there for my best friend.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: And I want to apologize...

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Because I know what I asked of you must have placed a burden on you.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Huh?

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: I said what I did back then just because you're family. I didn't realize.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
I really am sorry.
I know it was inconsiderate of me to push it onto you.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: It wasn't a burden, Momoi.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Really...?

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Really.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: After we talked that day, Momoi...

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: What you said ended up being the push I needed to try to keep helping her.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: So, if anything, I'm grateful to you.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Plus, I have a feeling that she was able to pick herself back up again because she felt encouraged every time she saw you on screen somewhere.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: So, thank you very much.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: I see...

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: I was able to help both of you guys...

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Yes, I can say that for certain.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Still, Momoi, I didn't expect to hear that you were basically feeling the same way as me.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Huh?

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Ever since that day, I've also been meaning to thank you.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: So, I really appreciate you creating this opportunity.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Hehe. I see.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Seriously, Ena doesn't realize just how lucky she is to have you as her brother!

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line:
I know, right?
And the same could be said about her best friend.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Anyway, Momoi...

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Hm?

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Please keep doing your best.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: I don't really know anything about idols...

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: But I do believe that the work you do is able to encourage people like Ena.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Thanks!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Hehe. Being told that makes me want to try even harder this year!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: While we're on the subject, Akito, you and your team are aiming to stand on top of the world, right?

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Wait, you know about that?

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
Ena told me.
Including the part about going over to the United States.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: I'm looking forward to seeing you become a globe-trotting artist. Maybe I should get your autograph now while I still can.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line:
We're nowhere near that level yet.
During this trip, we're just going over to see someone we know perform in a show.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
Still, that's great.
It's cool how you guys are thinking big and global!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Making that dream come true won't be easy, but I have a feeling that you and your team will succeed...

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
So, do your best.
I'll be rooting for you guys!

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Yes, thank you very much.

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: (Thank goodness.)

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: (She got a chance to tell him how she feels.)
